lead.headline: H.R. 1 fee increases take effect today for new filings
lead.deck: No new acts in the areas we track since yesterday; PERM and the Visa Bulletin remain unchanged.
body: Today, Oct. 16, DHS’s new FY2027 amounts under H.R. 1 take effect: I-131 at $1,050, initial EAD at $570, I-821 at $520 and enforcement fees of $5,300. Filings made from today must use the new amounts; confirm the current fee before every submission.
In the other tracked areas (DHS/USCIS, DOL/OFLC, EOIR, State Department), today’s sweep found no new act beyond those reported in yesterday’s edition.

deadlines: 11/09: OPT fee comments close. 11/13: comments close on the I-129 deference proposal and the refugee interim rule.
11/30: EB-5 final fee rule takes effect. 12/07: comments close on the I-90 and OPT information collections.
Visa Bulletin / PERM: check the November bulletin and FLAG. Official source: FLAG ↗

items.title: OPT: proposed $70,000 fee per initial recommendation — comments due 11/09
items.deck: ICE/DHS NPRM (91 FR 64566; docket ICEB-2026-0100): SEVP-certified schools would pay $70,000 for the first OPT recommendation and $30,000 for each subsequent one, before the SEVIS entry.
body: ICE/DHS NPRM (91 FR 64566; docket ICEB-2026-0100): SEVP-certified schools would pay $70,000 for the first OPT recommendation and $30,000 for each subsequent one, before the SEVIS entry. Effective 60 days after the final rule. Information-collection comments due 12/07.

items.title: I-129: end of deference to prior approvals — comments due 11/13
items.deck: Proposal to remove 8 CFR 214.1(c)(5) (91 FR 65119; docket USCIS-2026-0529), published Oct. 14.
body: Proposal to remove 8 CFR 214.1(c)(5) (91 FR 65119; docket USCIS-2026-0529), published Oct. 14. Nothing changes today; for H-1B/L-1 employers, reinforce documentation for each extension.

items.title: ICE/EOIR: final rule on civil immigration penalties
items.deck: Final rule (91 FR 65390) in effect since Oct. 14: appeal within 15 business days via Form 281, no BIA appeal, with late appeals accepted for documented mail delays.
body: Final rule (91 FR 65390) in effect since Oct. 14: appeal within 15 business days via Form 281, no BIA appeal, with late appeals accepted for documented mail delays.

lead.headline: Taxas da H.R. 1 valem a partir de hoje para novos protocolos
lead.deck: Sem atos novos nas áreas acompanhadas desde ontem; PERM e Visa Bulletin seguem sem mudança oficial.
body: Hoje, 16/10, entram em vigor os novos valores do DHS para o FY2027 decorrentes da H.R. 1: I-131 a US$1.050, EAD inicial a US$570, I-821 a US$520 e taxas de execução de US$5.300. Protocolos feitos a partir de hoje devem usar os valores novos; confira o valor vigente antes de cada envio.
Nas demais áreas acompanhadas (DHS/USCIS, DOL/OFLC, EOIR, Departamento de Estado), a varredura de hoje não encontrou ato novo além dos já noticiados na edição de ontem.
